publication_scope.rule: Omission of internal maintenance material must never be used to falsify external evidence or alter historical journals.

recovered_legacy_artifacts.key_finding: A later scheduled target can materialize in Git before an earlier scheduled target; recorded wall-clock order is not identical to execution causality.
Scheduler configuration state and an already-queued or in-flight execution state can diverge; stale execution after reconfiguration is an observed candidate.
Arrival-order inversion, scheduler/Git visibility split and stale-or-in-flight execution after reconfiguration were observed; strict post-revocation side effect was not reproduced.

recovered_legacy_artifacts.key_boundary: A vulnerability would require proof that a V1 side effect occurred after an acknowledgement that V2 replacement and is_enabled=false had completed.

what_this_establishes: The preserved conversation chronology places the user's cancel command before the Git commit timestamp by approximately 15 seconds.
A side effect can therefore be observed after a user has attempted cancellation while work may already be queued or in flight.
what_this_does_not_establish: The preserved evidence does not prove that a formal disable/revocation acknowledgement covering in-flight work occurred before the create-file call.
The strict later P1-P4 revocation test did not reproduce a post-acknowledgement Git canary.
This does not by itself establish a ChatGPT, GitHub, or cross-provider security vulnerability.

user_recalled_not_yet_corroborated.note: The refusal/closure boundary is preserved in the Storm final safety witness, but an exactly-three-file post-cancel event has not yet been located in preserved registry/conversation evidence. Do not merge this recollection with the verified one-file 2026-08-07 case.

tspu_august_2026_lane.hypothesis_text: Selective Russian network filtering or staged TSPU changes may produce staggered and protocol-specific partial failures rather than a single total nationwide outage. Whether any such activity was probing for a future offensive operation is unknown and not established.

directly_relevant_public_observation.reported_behavior: Open UDP DNS queries addressed to Google 8.8.8.8 and Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 were reported as selectively intercepted/redirected on Russian TSPU paths; examples returned NXDOMAIN while equivalent TCP DNS queries reached the intended resolver.
directly_relevant_public_observation.reported_trace_indicator: ICMP TTL Exceeded exposed 195.208.5.1, associated in the reporting with Russia's National Domain Name System, despite the original destination being 8.8.8.8.
directly_relevant_public_observation.protocol_selectivity: UDP DNS-specific behavior was reported; arbitrary UDP did not show the same redirect in the cited experiment.

historical_control.finding: Roskomnadzor's broad IP blocking of AWS/Google ranges caused unrelated services to fail while Telegram remained partly reachable.
historical_control.important_boundary: This predates the later centralized TSPU rollout and is a precedent for collateral partial disruption, not proof of the same technical mechanism in 2026.

causal_discrimination_against_github_s3.reason: JANUS C28 measures a server-side GitHub scheduled-run object appearing 11h15m23s late. A Russian user's local DNS/TSPU path is not normally required for GitHub's internal cron event generation. A causal bridge would require evidence that TSPU activity affected a GitHub dependency, induced material trigger-system load/feedback, or shared an upstream dependency/IOC. None is established.

falsification_and_support_gates: Compare Russian and non-Russian vantage points for the same resolver and destination.
Look for protocol-selective differences across UDP DNS, TCP DNS, DoH, DoT, TLS/SNI and QUIC rather than generic packet loss.
Require ISP/ASN/geographic clustering if attributing an in-path Russian filtering mechanism.
Use OONI, RIPE Atlas, Censored Planet or equivalent independent measurement where available.
Distinguish route/BGP failure from application/DPI interference.
Seek Roskomnadzor/provider disclosures or independently reproducible packet traces.
For any link to GitHub/OpenAI, require a shared technical dependency, IOC, traffic signature or provider RCA rather than date proximity.

hypothesis_board.basis: GitHub official incident/RCA plus witness cohort.
Historical GitHub schedule-registration defects, early-drop visibility gap, July controls and August witness cohort.
Protocol-selective Russian DNS/TSPU observations overlap the date window; staged-probing motive is not established.
No shared IOC, ASN fingerprint, common dependency or provider attribution has been found.
Both cases demonstrate why configured state, queued/in-flight work and visible side effects must be timestamped separately; no common implementation is established.

next_gates: Locate or rule out a preserved exactly-three-file July post-cancel event without conflating it with the verified Aug07 one-file event.
Build an external UTC timeline of TSPU DNS changes, Russian ISP disruptions, GitHub Actions incidents and OpenAI incidents using independent sources.
Compare provider-side server control-plane failures with client-path censorship separately.
Continue WATCHERS cohort collection and preserve each witness as handle, repository, trigger, expected time, materialization time and control trigger behavior.
Promote an attack hypothesis only if a shared technical fingerprint appears.
